_about: V11 gold set of canonical biology->engineering cases (rediscovery ground truth). Mechanisms and applications are the textbook/literature consensus; quantitative claims are deliberately omitted here (see research_notes/.../03_bioinspiration_validity_evidence.md). 'commons_query' is used to fetch one CC-licensed photo per organism from Wikimedia Commons; licences are recorded per image in images_manifest.json.

cases.structure: leaf surface with micropapillae covered in nanoscale wax tubules
cases.mechanism: hierarchical roughness + hydrophobic wax keeps droplets in the Cassie state; rolling drops pick up dirt (self-cleaning)
cases.application: self-cleaning superhydrophobic coatings, facade paints, glass

cases.structure: toe pads with lamellae of setae branching into spatulae
cases.mechanism: van der Waals contact splitting through hierarchical fibrils gives reversible dry adhesion
cases.application: dry fibrillar adhesives, climbing robots, reusable grippers

cases.structure: skin covered in ribbed placoid scales (denticles) aligned with flow
cases.mechanism: streamwise riblets damp near-wall turbulent cross-flow, reducing skin-friction drag in a spacing window
cases.application: riblet films for aircraft, ship hulls, pipelines, swimsuits

cases.structure: hexagonal wax cells with thin shared walls
cases.mechanism: hexagonal cellular structure maximises stiffness and storage per unit material
cases.application: honeycomb sandwich panels for aircraft, drones, packaging

cases.structure: hollow bone with internal trabecular struts aligned to load
cases.mechanism: graded strut lattice places material along principal stress paths for high stiffness at low mass
cases.application: lightweight lattice/truss cores, additive-manufactured brackets

cases.structure: wing scales with ridges carrying stacked lamellae (Christmas-tree nanostructure)
cases.mechanism: multilayer thin-film interference produces iridescent structural blue without pigment
cases.application: pigment-free structural colour coatings, anti-counterfeiting, displays

cases.structure: elytra with hydrophilic bumps on a waxy hydrophobic background
cases.mechanism: fog droplets impact and coalesce on the bumps, then roll to the mouth along hydrophobic channels
cases.application: fog-harvesting meshes and surfaces for arid regions

cases.structure: hydrophobic hairs holding an air plastron / silk diving bell
cases.mechanism: a plastron acts as a physical gill: O2 diffuses in from water across the air-water interface
cases.application: underwater breathing membranes, oxygen-supply plastron surfaces

cases.structure: triangular hairs covering the body
cases.mechanism: hairs reflect visible/near-IR sunlight (total internal reflection/Mie scattering) and raise mid-IR emissivity for radiative cooling
cases.application: passive daytime radiative cooling coatings

cases.structure: skin with a network of fine cracks/channels
cases.mechanism: crack network retains water by capillarity, prolonging evaporative cooling
cases.application: evaporative-cooling building skins and wet facades

cases.structure: interwoven arteries and veins in the leg
cases.mechanism: counter-current heat exchange returns heat to the body, limiting loss to cold water
cases.application: counter-current heat recovery exchangers, heat-recovery ventilators
cases.commons_query: Ardea cinerea standing in water legs

cases.structure: skin scales with interconnected capillary channels between them
cases.mechanism: capillary channels wick water across the skin to the mouth
cases.application: passive capillary water transport/wicking surfaces

cases.structure: porous earthen mound with internal conduits and thick walls
cases.mechanism: thermal mass and diurnal temperature swings drive ventilation and buffer interior temperature
cases.application: passive ventilation and thermal buffering in buildings (e.g. Eastgate Centre)

cases.structure: long tapered wedge-shaped beak
cases.mechanism: gradual cross-section change reduces pressure-wave build-up when entering a denser medium
cases.application: Shinkansen 500-series nose redesign to reduce tunnel boom

cases.structure: burrs with hooked spines
cases.mechanism: flexible hooks mechanically interlock with loops/fibres
cases.application: hook-and-loop fasteners (Velcro)

cases.structure: tubercles along the flipper leading edge
cases.mechanism: tubercles create streamwise vortices that delay stall at high angle of attack
cases.application: tubercled blades for wind turbines, fans, hydrofoils

cases.structure: cuticle with re-entrant nanoscale comb-like texture
cases.mechanism: re-entrant geometry gives omniphobic plastron, repelling even low-surface-tension liquids
cases.application: omniphobic/oil-repellent surfaces, anti-fouling membranes

cases.structure: conical spines with barbs and graded grooves
cases.mechanism: Laplace pressure gradient on conical spines and wettability gradient transport fog droplets to the base
cases.application: fog collection with conical/gradient structures

cases.structure: elytra with multilayer epicuticle
cases.mechanism: multilayer reflector produces metallic structural colour
cases.application: structural-colour films and coatings

cases.structure: large floating leaf with radial and concentric underside ribs
cases.mechanism: ribbed network stiffens a thin lamina so it carries load at low mass
cases.application: ribbed lightweight roof/floor structures (Crystal Palace)

cases.structure: peristome with microgrooves holding a stable water film
cases.mechanism: lubricated slippery surface: insects aquaplane on the liquid film
cases.application: slippery liquid-infused porous surfaces (SLIPS), anti-fouling

cases.structure: dense overlapping feathers trapping air
cases.mechanism: trapped still air layer gives very low effective conductivity (insulation)
cases.application: insulating textiles and aerogel-like layers

cases.structure: byssal threads ending in adhesive plaques rich in DOPA proteins
cases.mechanism: catechol (DOPA) chemistry gives wet adhesion
cases.application: wet/underwater adhesives, surgical glues

cases.structure: continuous micro-conduits from roots to leaves
cases.mechanism: capillarity and transpiration-driven negative pressure lift water
cases.application: passive wicking/pumping (synthetic trees, capillary loop heat pipes)
